{{Quote|In serving me, you serve the Emperor.|Arzanon|<ref name="Allegiance" />}}
'''Arzanon''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith Inquisitor]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was the head of security at the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]], and worked with an [[Unidentified Intelligence officer|Intelligence officer]] to search for traitor [[Sith acolyte/Legends|acolytes]] who wanted to throw down the [[Tenebrae|Emperor's]] [[Sith Order (Sith Empire)|Order]]. He was a fanatic loyalist to the Sith Emperor, constantly mentioning him.<ref name="Allegiance" /> In [[3637 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> Arzanon was [[Death/Legends|killed]] when a Republic strike team landed on Korriban.<ref name="Assault Republic" />

==Behind the scenes==
Arzanon is introduced in the mission "Allegiance" for Sith classes in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Allegiance" />
